content_md:
My blyg is now close enough to what I’d envisioned, remaining gaps feel extra frustrating. But there are also the reality has different emergent properties. There’s a lot more social stubbing than I expected and less forking, and not much threading with transcludes yet. I think it’s because the reference client layout looks like a short-posts feed blog like tumblr etc. gonna give it a redesign to focus on more long-form thread-based affordances.

Strong synchronic bias. I need to amp up the diachronic. Pins, threads, and forks are going to be the next focus. Hoppers are barely developed at all.
